description: This file defines classes and functions for managing a process-global profiler state in a distributed RPC context within the PyTorch framework. It includes class definitions for 'State' and 'StateStackEntry', as well as functions to enable and disable profiling ranges, and manage a stack of profiling states.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Manages profiling range information and results, supporting nested profiling ranges.

classes.name: StateStackEntry
classes.description: Implements a stack of 'State' objects for managing nested profiling states.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Constructor initializing the profiling state with a given configuration.

methods.name: pushResult
methods.description: Pushes a profiling result into the current state's result container.

methods.name: results
methods.description: Retrieves the list of profiling results.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current 'StateStackEntry' in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: prevPtr
methods.description: Returns the previous 'StateStackEntry' in the stack.

methods.name: statePtr
methods.description: Returns the 'State' associated with this stack entry.

methods.name: pushRange
methods.description: Pushes a new profiling range onto the stack.

methods.name: popRange
methods.description: Pops the current profiling range from the stack.

methods.name: enableServer
methods.description: Starts a server-side process-global profiling range with a specified configuration.

methods.name: disableServer
methods.description: Ends the server-side profiling range and returns collected profiling results.
